submission.justification: Radiator-R3 at 2.5 cm gives the best simulated pion/kaon separation at 10 GeV/c among all simulated candidate/thickness combinations: 4.784 sigma, exceeding the 3.5 sigma hard requirement and outperforming R1 and R2. The selected thickness is within the allowed 1–6 cm range. However, the humidity-ageing transparency-loss data were not found for any candidate, so the hard requirement of ≤10% transparency loss after the 10-year-equivalent humidity ageing test is unverified. This is therefore the best performance recommendation from the available simulation data, but final compliance requires humidity-ageing data before construction approval.
